statement: The ammonia price's three sensitivity points are three different quantities: the low end 0.439 is a US Gulf Coast FOB price for 2025 that its source marks as estimated; the base 0.530 is the EU CIF import unit value for 2025; the high end 0.726 is the EU CIF value for January to September 2026, outside the price's own cost year.  The README calls them the lowest and highest figure the sources span.  The base's own dataset gives same-basis 2025 ends: monthly unit values from 0.380 (June) to 0.692 (November).  Arithmetic recomputed by the reviewing session.
